repos.description: owner/name arguments, or from stdin a JSON array of names or objects with full_name, or a github-repo-finder (repos), repo-health-checker (healthy) or rule-filter (kept) result

max_setup_commands.description: More commands than this in the setup instructions is a difficulty

max_ci_minutes.description: CI slower than this is a difficulty, twice as slow a bigger one

max_size_mb.description: A bigger repository is slow to clone

entry.description: The input entry, unchanged (a name becomes {full_name}), with a setup field added

reasons.description: What made it easier or harder, or why it could not be read

facts.description: Missing when the repository could not be read

tree_truncated.description: GitHub listed only part of a very large repository

docker.description: A Dockerfile or compose file in the root

build_tools.description: Named by files in the root, such as Gradle (wrapper included), uv, CMake

ecosystems.description: Toolchains to install, from build files no deeper than one folder, outside examples, tests, docs and vendored code

setup_doc.description: The document the setup instructions came from

setup_commands.description: Command lines in the setup, build and test sections

setup_excerpt.description: Those sections, cut to 1500 characters, for a person or a model to read

ci_median_minutes.description: Until the slowest workflow of a PR commit finished, median

ci_commits.description: PR commits the CI time was measured on

unknown.description: Not found, or GitHub could not be read
